decisions.reason: Launched only in 2023 with its own page, its value is still uncertain and a software analysis tool costs little to maintain, so keeping the option open is sensible.
The gas tariff comparison has a dedicated page and serves the firm's core energy-data niche, so after one year there is no evidence yet to justify abandoning it.
The regional electricity calculator is prominently presented and cheap to run, and its prospects have not resolved enough to warrant dropping it.
It is only mentioned and overlaps with the electricity and gas calculators, which raises the chance it gets merged or removed, but its low holding cost favours keeping it for now.
The area definition tool has its own page and likely supports the other location-based products, so it is a low-cost option worth keeping.
Its limited presence and overlap with the gas tariff comparison suggest weaker commitment, but one year of results is too little evidence to abandon a cheap software option.
